_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F13, a choice: the clerk who wrote the names (spare: mercy; a confession for the king: trust, c3.confession; smash his inkwell: vengeance).

text.zh_TW: 一個戴眼鏡的書記縮在桌子底下，懷裡抱著一本厚厚的帳簿。「我、我只是負責寫字的！名字是他們說，我寫！」
text.en: A clerk in spectacles cowers under a desk, hugging a thick record book. "I-I only do the writing! They say the names, I write them down!"

label.en: "Then write a confession for the king."

text.zh_TW: 書記愣了一下，抱著帳簿逃走了。
text.en: The clerk blinks, then flees with his book.

text.zh_TW: 書記顫抖著寫完，蓋上收集者的印章。「這、這是全部了。主人的命令……都在上面。」凱把供詞收進鎧甲裡：「王都會看到的。」
text.en: The clerk writes with shaking hands and stamps it with the Collectors' seal. "Th-that's all of it. The Master's orders... all there." Kai tucks the confession into his armour. "The capital will see this."

text.zh_TW: 墨水潑滿了整張桌子。書記哭著跑了。凱看著你，什麼也沒說。
text.en: Ink splashes across the whole desk. The clerk runs off in tears. Kai looks at you and says nothing.
